title: feat(plugin-gantt)!: remove the mobile QR share (移动端二维码) context-menu feature
body:
## What

Remove the QR-share feature from the gantt outright:

- **GanttView**: the 「移动端二维码」 context-menu item, the QR dialog, the `qrShare/qrDataUrl/qrCopied` state + encode/copy logic, the `taskUrl` prop and its type, the `qrcode` / lucide `QrCode/Copy/Check` imports. `taskUrl` alone no longer justifies opening the context menu (it would be an empty popover).
- **ObjectGantt**: the `taskUrl` URL-building wiring (the drawer's 整页 link via `recordDetailHref` is untouched).
- **i18n**: `gantt.menu.qrcode` + `gantt.qr.*` keys removed from the component defaults and the en/zh locale packs.
- **deps**: `qrcode` / `@types/qrcode` dropped from plugin-gantt (the `qrcode` **field type** elsewhere in the repo is unrelated and untouched).
- **tests**: all QR suites deleted (GanttView.enhancements, ObjectGantt.persistfilters taskUrl block).

First commit was a comment-out; the second commit supersedes it with full removal — squash-merge collapses them.

## Why

#2460 item 7 generalized one consumer app's requirement (scan-to-open a record on mobile) into the generic gantt renderer, and what it encoded — the desktop console record URL — was the wrong target even for that requirement. Scan-to-mobile flows belong app-side against the app's own mobile surface. Removing rather than gating: nothing platform-generic remains worth keeping.

## Verification

- plugin-gantt: 32 test files, 334/334 pass; `tsc --noEmit` clean; `vite build` OK
- @object-ui/i18n: build OK, 89/89 tests pass
- lint: 21 pre-existing errors (baseline had 22 — one lived in the deleted QR tests); zero new
- repo-wide grep: no `taskUrl` / gantt-QR references remain
